ayahs.textAr: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
ayahs.textEn: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
ayahs.textEn: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”

ayahs.textAr: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
ayahs.textEn: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
ayahs.textEn: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent.

ayahs.textAr: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.textEn: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺.

ayahs.textAr: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
ayahs.textEn: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller

ayahs.textAr: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts,

ayahs.textAr: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”

ayahs.textAr: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
ayahs.textEn: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated.

ayahs.textAr: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
ayahs.textEn: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”

ayahs.textAr: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain,

ayahs.textAr: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
ayahs.textEn: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set.

ayahs.textAr: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails,

ayahs.textAr: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.textEn: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful?

ayahs.textAr: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textEn: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?

ayahs.textAr: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textEn: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery,

ayahs.textAr: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees.

ayahs.textAr: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textEn: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?

ayahs.textAr: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textEn: Thamûd rejected the warnings ˹as well˺,

ayahs.textAr: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.textEn: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane.

ayahs.textAr: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”

ayahs.textAr: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
ayahs.textEn: ˹It was revealed to salih,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
ayahs.textEn: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience.

ayahs.textAr: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”

ayahs.textAr: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.textEn: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺.

ayahs.textAr: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textEn: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?

ayahs.textAr: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textEn: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn

ayahs.textAr: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
ayahs.textEn: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textEn: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textEn: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
ayahs.textEn: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment.

ayahs.textAr: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textEn: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.textEn: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh.

ayahs.textAr: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
ayahs.textEn: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful.

ayahs.textAr: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.textEn: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books?

ayahs.textAr: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”?

ayahs.textAr: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee.

ayahs.textAr: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
ayahs.textEn: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes.

ayahs.textAr: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.textEn: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained.

ayahs.textAr: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
ayahs.textEn: Our command done in the blink of an eye.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful?

ayahs.textAr: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.textEn: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records.

ayahs.textAr: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
ayahs.textEn: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers,

ayahs.textAr: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
ayahs.textEn: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.
